+canonical record/preflight source. Public upstream source is referenced by pinned

+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+PR264 landed as `1045e729c391c47a9b6a895782a2fa69dc6fa044`; its
+[immutable documentation acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96911f50e2a8fb7db0b7361485b5075832e67a47/docs/review-assets/spn-144-registration-7aee6699)
+retains both100/100 exact-head reviews and all seven documentation gates. Runtime
+and Storybook execution were explicitly inapplicable, not credited as tests.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 public
+[handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc),
+[configuration](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_config.cc),
+[backend](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_tracing_backend.cc)
+and [consumer](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/perfetto/consumer_host.cc)
+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.
+
+The pinned Chromium tree references Perfetto commit
+`403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649`. Its public
+[launcher manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649/tools/trace_processor)
+pins official native v58.2 binaries, including mac-arm64 SHA256
+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`
+(13,597,976 bytes), and linux-amd64 SHA256
+`58042408e6cc861fb1a731c26bb082dc222285561eaa4e12a48a8b2b90dca7b9`
+(14,897,560 bytes). The prebuilt release is not asserted byte-identical to Chromium's
+linked library. [Public conversion documentation](https://perfetto.dev/docs/quickstart/traceconv)
+supports native proto→Chrome JSON; conversion is not assumed universally lossless.
+Read the manifest only; no Python launcher is added or executed.
+
+Declare one finite local capability sequence, separate from application acceptance:
+
+- Download the exact mac-arm64 official binary once into a task-owned temporary
+  directory, require the manifest size/hash before making it executable, and run
+  version/convert-help/query-help once each (10s per metadata command). Stop if
+  the expected supported commands or identity cannot be established.
+- Run exactly one JSON and one proto capture sequentially on the installed pinned
+  Chromium, fresh isolated contexts, synthetic local HTTP page, same full six trace
+  categories/non-overwriting1GiB buffer and4× CPU throttle. The fixture installs one
+  cancelled timeout, an interval firing exactly three times and one final timeout,
+  with named functions, known source and native text input. This is a short protocol
+  capability fixture, not a smaller substitute for the2086-input acceptance workload.
+- Keep complete raw outputs and source bytes with SHA256. Convert the proto once
+  with the verified native tool; inspect nonzero error/data-loss statistics once.
+  Require all known timer identities/install/fire/remove behavior, callable source/
+  stack fields, timestamps/durations and complete JSON parsing under the existing
+  reader. Compare normalized fixture contracts, not unrelated background event
+  counts or a byte-for-byte equivalence of separate captures.
+- Run one malformed-protobuf conversion negative control; require failure, retain
+  its diagnostics and reject any partial output. This cannot prove all corruption
+  detection or full-trace semantic equivalence; later implementation controls must
+  bind transport/converted identities and reject ambiguous conversion.
+- Bounds:120s overall after metadata preflight,30s per capture/collection,20s per
+  converter/statistics process,5s for malformed input;64MiB raw per capture and
+  256MiB converted output. Serialize under the existing normal-pressure/2GiB combined
+  process-tree watchdog. Retain first failure and authorize no automatic repetition.
+  Always close known CDP streams, detach sessions, close contexts/browser/HTTP server
+  and terminate owned child processes; keep successful evidence, remove only owned
+  partial outputs. A timeout never becomes a pass because cleanup later succeeds.
+
+Only a complete pass admits further investigation of this supported architecture.
+It does not establish full historical420s headroom, full event-equivalence, hosted
+resource bounds or fix the original failure. A failure rejects the proposed
+capability as observed; inspect its concrete cause before revising any plan. The
+eventual candidate still needs complete native pairs and all original acceptance.
+Operator trades a pinned additional development tool for potentially bounded export;
+Owner/Collaborator require full source/lifetime fidelity, and Link guest retains
+unchanged access checks. No production dependency, UI change or authority expansion
+is selected by this checkpoint.
+
+Metadata preflight passed once: exact manifest bytes/hash, native version
+`Perfetto v58.2-add693d8b (add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897)`, RPC14,

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+PR264 landed as `1045e729c391c47a9b6a895782a2fa69dc6fa044`; its
+[immutable documentation acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96911f50e2a8fb7db0b7361485b5075832e67a47/docs/review-assets/spn-144-registration-7aee6699)
+retains both100/100 exact-head reviews and all seven documentation gates. Runtime
+and Storybook execution were explicitly inapplicable, not credited as tests.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 public
+[handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc),
+[configuration](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_config.cc),
+[backend](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_tracing_backend.cc)
+and [consumer](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/perfetto/consumer_host.cc)
+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.
+
+The pinned Chromium tree references Perfetto commit
+`403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649`. Its public
+[launcher manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649/tools/trace_processor)
+pins official native v58.2 binaries, including mac-arm64 SHA256
+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`
+(13,597,976 bytes), and linux-amd64 SHA256
+`58042408e6cc861fb1a731c26bb082dc222285561eaa4e12a48a8b2b90dca7b9`
+(14,897,560 bytes). The prebuilt release is not asserted byte-identical to Chromium's
+linked library. [Public conversion documentation](https://perfetto.dev/docs/quickstart/traceconv)
+supports native proto→Chrome JSON; conversion is not assumed universally lossless.
+Read the manifest only; no Python launcher is added or executed.
+
+Declare one finite local capability sequence, separate from application acceptance:
+
+- Download the exact mac-arm64 official binary once into a task-owned temporary
+  directory, require the manifest size/hash before making it executable, and run
+  version/convert-help/query-help once each (10s per metadata command). Stop if
+  the expected supported commands or identity cannot be established.
+- Run exactly one JSON and one proto capture sequentially on the installed pinned
+  Chromium, fresh isolated contexts, synthetic local HTTP page, same full six trace
+  categories/non-overwriting1GiB buffer and4× CPU throttle. The fixture installs one
+  cancelled timeout, an interval firing exactly three times and one final timeout,
+  with named functions, known source and native text input. This is a short protocol
+  capability fixture, not a smaller substitute for the2086-input acceptance workload.
+- Keep complete raw outputs and source bytes with SHA256. Convert the proto once
+  with the verified native tool; inspect nonzero error/data-loss statistics once.
+  Require all known timer identities/install/fire/remove behavior, callable source/
+  stack fields, timestamps/durations and complete JSON parsing under the existing
+  reader. Compare normalized fixture contracts, not unrelated background event
+  counts or a byte-for-byte equivalence of separate captures.
+- Run one malformed-protobuf conversion negative control; require failure, retain
+  its diagnostics and reject any partial output. This cannot prove all corruption
+  detection or full-trace semantic equivalence; later implementation controls must
+  bind transport/converted identities and reject ambiguous conversion.
+- Bounds:120s overall after metadata preflight,30s per capture/collection,20s per
+  converter/statistics process,5s for malformed input;64MiB raw per capture and
+  256MiB converted output. Serialize under the existing normal-pressure/2GiB combined
+  process-tree watchdog. Retain first failure and authorize no automatic repetition.
+  Always close known CDP streams, detach sessions, close contexts/browser/HTTP server
+  and terminate owned child processes; keep successful evidence, remove only owned
+  partial outputs. A timeout never becomes a pass because cleanup later succeeds.
+
+Only a complete pass admits further investigation of this supported architecture.
+It does not establish full historical420s headroom, full event-equivalence, hosted
+resource bounds or fix the original failure. A failure rejects the proposed
+capability as observed; inspect its concrete cause before revising any plan. The
+eventual candidate still needs complete native pairs and all original acceptance.
+Operator trades a pinned additional development tool for potentially bounded export;
+Owner/Collaborator require full source/lifetime fidelity, and Link guest retains
+unchanged access checks. No production dependency, UI change or authority expansion
+is selected by this checkpoint.
+
+Metadata preflight passed once: exact manifest bytes/hash, native version
+`Perfetto v58.2-add693d8b (add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897)`, RPC14,
+convert-json and query help. Watchdog956ms/182960KiB sampled peak, normal pressure.
+The pinned release's query help specifies CSV output and does not expose the newer
+website's format/agent flags; use only its supported arguments. No browser has
+run for this probe yet. Probe script SHA256 before execution:
+`7df58b43219ff3d15430457b04c9d6e8583fded4f2c36a0fee52e924d947db93`.
+The external watchdog keeps the same pressure/2GiB rules and tightens its wall
+limit from475s to130s, allowing at most10s failure cleanup beyond the probe's120s
+success deadline. This is not a change to the420s application acceptance budget.
+
+### 🚫 First capability result: conversion is permissive on truncated input
+
+The declared probe ran once and **failed** its negative control. Both captures
+completed on actual Chromium156.0.8078.4 with unchanged settings and positive
+stream/session/context/browser/server cleanup. JSON retained411781bytes SHA256
+`accef97b28f622c3998e3403d16973422fd37030504ea23354ee8f46fb468713`;
+proto retained136693bytes SHA256
+`50a46a4f2151840f1252cab658cdc84b8e3896835790eb75a018266cb6489c8d`.
+The same three known timer installs, cancelled timeout with zero fires, three
+interval fires/removal, final timeout fire, source/script/line/column fields,
+named FunctionCalls/durations and markers passed in native JSON and converted
+proto. Existing strict JSON reader accepted both complete envelopes. Separate
+captures have different background events/timings; no complete event equivalence
+or performance gain is inferred. Proto conversion produced357203bytes in135.367ms.
+
+The statistics query reports no nonzero error/data_loss rows. Both conversion
+and query retain an stderr warning that arm64 syscall traces are unsupported;
+this fixture does not capture syscalls, but the warning must not be erased or
+presented as universal conversion support. The binary is release58.2/add693d8b,
+not the Chromium-linked403906f4 build.
+
+The malformed6bytes `0a ff ff ff 7f 01` declare a TracePacket much larger than
+the available payload. The converter nevertheless exits0 after69.541ms. Its
+partial output was deleted as declared; raw malformed input and command diagnostics
+remain. Overall probe3817.145ms, watchdog4285ms/558864KiB sampled peak, normal
+pressure. Terminal remains failed; successful fixture subchecks do not admit the
+original unguarded converter architecture. No native capture is repeated.
+
+The public release [Trace schema](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897/protos/perfetto/trace/trace.proto)
+defines only repeated length-delimited TracePacket field1. This supports a narrow
+next investigation: strict streaming outer-envelope validation before conversion,
+including exact declared-length consumption and EOF, while preserving every
+packet byte. It is not a replacement protobuf semantic decoder. Full source/
+identity binding, parser statistics, actual callback attribution and meaningful
+negative controls remain necessary. The accepted empty conversion exposes an
+explicit completeness boundary; extending the timeout or rerunning the browser
+cannot repair it. Independent review and a prospective retained-data-only checkpoint
+precede any revised admission result.
+
+### 🧱 Retained-data checkpoint: strict outer-envelope guard
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution.** Independent nonimplementing
+review confirms the concrete268435455-byte packet claim versus one available
+payload byte. A separately bounded offline framing investigation is justified;
+it cannot validate opaque inner packet semantics, detect a missing whole final
+packet, establish full converter fidelity or predict deadline headroom.
+
+Declare one browserless execution on the already retained136693-byte proto, with
+its original raw SHA256 required at chunk sizes1/2/7/65536. Validate only field1's
+length-delimited wrapper, uint32 length bounds, exact payload consumption and EOF;
+retain every payload byte unchanged. Exercise12 malformed/empty/overflow/wrong-tag/
+wrong-wire/trailing/incomplete cases at chunk sizes1/7, including the original6byte
+failure; a spy records zero invalid inputs admitted to conversion. Also reject a
+truncated retained final payload and a raw-byte bound violation. Explicit controls
+show that a complete empty packet and opaque invalid inner bytes still pass this
+framing layer, so it cannot be mistaken for semantic or whole-trace acceptance.
+
+No browser or converter is rerun. Budget30s/normal pressure/2GiB process-tree
+watchdog; stop and preserve the first failed assertion. Guard SHA256
+`ac3e7a0e81cd6faf0bffe09d1a2c4d892fc567b2e4b6cfe21320bddae010f390`,
+verifier SHA256 `124c3909aff9037fd4d5a0c46e67106e11fd4ae18c6f164280f3b61c2ac5813b`.
+A pass establishes this narrow guard's feasibility and rejects the observed
+truncation before conversion. The first native capability probe remains failed;
+implementation admission still needs explicit transport/derived-output identity,
+converter-error/statistics and known semantic/attribution contracts, then full
+native acceptance with unchanged categories/workload/deadline.
+
+That offline execution passed once: the retained136693bytes contain2441 complete
+packets at every declared chunk size with the original hash unchanged. All24
+malformed cases, truncated retained payload and input-bound violation reject;
+complete empty and opaque-invalid packets pass framing as explicitly documented

+## 🧭 Converter authority checkpoint and retained-source verification
+
+Read-only version investigation found a concrete compatibility limit in the
+initial58.2 selection: its build predates Chromium's linked Perfetto403906f4.
+That producer-era commit fixes silently ignored producer descriptor annotations
+(PID/TID/flag metadata). The current official
+[v59.1 release](https://github.com/google/perfetto/releases/tag/v59.1), published
+2026-10-27, includes403906f4 as an ancestor. This supports investigating a newer
+pinned converter instead of treating the old launcher manifest as sufficient
+fidelity authority. It does not itself prove equivalent output or repair the
+observed deadline. The original58.2 negative failure stays failed.
+
+**Prospective, before execution:** fetch the exact59.1 mac-arm64 binary from the
+[immutable official manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/f5cb5074e59208ec89c65aeeed53cc9cf6204cd5/tools/trace_processor),
+14,376,168bytes/SHA256
+`8488edbefadfc4be152cda1d42d9bfcede8b47638295eb85eb3bad8cd148fdf4`.
+Verify before execution; run version, convert help and query help once each with
+10s bounds. No Python wrapper, browser capture or application retry is permitted
+by this preflight. Its eventual Linux counterpart is15,885,448bytes/SHA256
+`2434129a3af4dc9e2034a476f7b76447b490975213e301769310d3bd0d5d6458`;
+it is not downloaded or executed locally. Declare the finite retained-input
+conversion/semantic checks after reading the actual supported59.1 CLI, preserving
+all prior results and the distinction between framing and full native acceptance.

+`v59.1-1e9c61e98` / `1e9c61e9844affd7dccd3d42d9ea9f3a3d10cf6d`.

+one statistics query with explicit CSV output (the59.1 CLI otherwise changes

 Storybook dispositions and accepted native storage/comparison evidence are separate.
+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+PR264 landed as `1045e729c391c47a9b6a895782a2fa69dc6fa044`; its
+[immutable documentation acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96911f50e2a8fb7db0b7361485b5075832e67a47/docs/review-assets/spn-144-registration-7aee6699)
+retains both100/100 exact-head reviews and all seven documentation gates. Runtime
+and Storybook execution were explicitly inapplicable, not credited as tests.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 public
+[handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc),
+[configuration](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_config.cc),
+[backend](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_tracing_backend.cc)
+and [consumer](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/perfetto/consumer_host.cc)
+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.
+
+The pinned Chromium tree references Perfetto commit
+`403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649`. Its public
+[launcher manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649/tools/trace_processor)
+pins official native v58.2 binaries, including mac-arm64 SHA256
+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`
+(13,597,976 bytes), and linux-amd64 SHA256
+`58042408e6cc861fb1a731c26bb082dc222285561eaa4e12a48a8b2b90dca7b9`
+(14,897,560 bytes). The prebuilt release is not asserted byte-identical to Chromium's
+linked library. [Public conversion documentation](https://perfetto.dev/docs/quickstart/traceconv)
+supports native proto→Chrome JSON; conversion is not assumed universally lossless.
+Read the manifest only; no Python launcher is added or executed.
+

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+PR264 landed as `1045e729c391c47a9b6a895782a2fa69dc6fa044`; its
+[immutable documentation acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96911f50e2a8fb7db0b7361485b5075832e67a47/docs/review-assets/spn-144-registration-7aee6699)
+retains both100/100 exact-head reviews and all seven documentation gates. Runtime
+and Storybook execution were explicitly inapplicable, not credited as tests.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 public
+[handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc),
+[configuration](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_config.cc),
+[backend](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_tracing_backend.cc)
+and [consumer](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/perfetto/consumer_host.cc)
+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.
+
+The pinned Chromium tree references Perfetto commit
+`403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649`. Its public
+[launcher manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649/tools/trace_processor)
+pins official native v58.2 binaries, including mac-arm64 SHA256
+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`
+(13,597,976 bytes), and linux-amd64 SHA256
+`58042408e6cc861fb1a731c26bb082dc222285561eaa4e12a48a8b2b90dca7b9`
+(14,897,560 bytes). The prebuilt release is not asserted byte-identical to Chromium's
+linked library. [Public conversion documentation](https://perfetto.dev/docs/quickstart/traceconv)
+supports native proto→Chrome JSON; conversion is not assumed universally lossless.
+Read the manifest only; no Python launcher is added or executed.
+
+Declare one finite local capability sequence, separate from application acceptance:
+
+- Download the exact mac-arm64 official binary once into a task-owned temporary
+  directory, require the manifest size/hash before making it executable, and run
+  version/convert-help/query-help once each (10s per metadata command). Stop if
+  the expected supported commands or identity cannot be established.
+- Run exactly one JSON and one proto capture sequentially on the installed pinned
+  Chromium, fresh isolated contexts, synthetic local HTTP page, same full six trace
+  categories/non-overwriting1GiB buffer and4× CPU throttle. The fixture installs one
+  cancelled timeout, an interval firing exactly three times and one final timeout,
+  with named functions, known source and native text input. This is a short protocol
+  capability fixture, not a smaller substitute for the2086-input acceptance workload.
+- Keep complete raw outputs and source bytes with SHA256. Convert the proto once
+  with the verified native tool; inspect nonzero error/data-loss statistics once.
+  Require all known timer identities/install/fire/remove behavior, callable source/
+  stack fields, timestamps/durations and complete JSON parsing under the existing
+  reader. Compare normalized fixture contracts, not unrelated background event
+  counts or a byte-for-byte equivalence of separate captures.
+- Run one malformed-protobuf conversion negative control; require failure, retain
+  its diagnostics and reject any partial output. This cannot prove all corruption
+  detection or full-trace semantic equivalence; later implementation controls must
+  bind transport/converted identities and reject ambiguous conversion.
+- Bounds:120s overall after metadata preflight,30s per capture/collection,20s per
+  converter/statistics process,5s for malformed input;64MiB raw per capture and
+  256MiB converted output. Serialize under the existing normal-pressure/2GiB combined
+  process-tree watchdog. Retain first failure and authorize no automatic repetition.
+  Always close known CDP streams, detach sessions, close contexts/browser/HTTP server
+  and terminate owned child processes; keep successful evidence, remove only owned
+  partial outputs. A timeout never becomes a pass because cleanup later succeeds.
+
+Only a complete pass admits further investigation of this supported architecture.
+It does not establish full historical420s headroom, full event-equivalence, hosted
+resource bounds or fix the original failure. A failure rejects the proposed
+capability as observed; inspect its concrete cause before revising any plan. The
+eventual candidate still needs complete native pairs and all original acceptance.
+Operator trades a pinned additional development tool for potentially bounded export;
+Owner/Collaborator require full source/lifetime fidelity, and Link guest retains
+unchanged access checks. No production dependency, UI change or authority expansion
+is selected by this checkpoint.
+
+Metadata preflight passed once: exact manifest bytes/hash, native version
+`Perfetto v58.2-add693d8b (add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897)`, RPC14,
+convert-json and query help. Watchdog956ms/182960KiB sampled peak, normal pressure.

+success deadline. This is not a change to the420s application acceptance budget.

+### 🚫 First capability result: conversion is permissive on truncated input
+
+The declared probe ran once and **failed** its negative control. Both captures
+completed on actual Chromium156.0.8078.4 with unchanged settings and positive
+stream/session/context/browser/server cleanup. JSON retained411781bytes SHA256
+`accef97b28f622c3998e3403d16973422fd37030504ea23354ee8f46fb468713`;
+proto retained136693bytes SHA256
+`50a46a4f2151840f1252cab658cdc84b8e3896835790eb75a018266cb6489c8d`.
+The same three known timer installs, cancelled timeout with zero fires, three
+interval fires/removal, final timeout fire, source/script/line/column fields,
+named FunctionCalls/durations and markers passed in native JSON and converted
+proto. Existing strict JSON reader accepted both complete envelopes. Separate
+captures have different background events/timings; no complete event equivalence
+or performance gain is inferred. Proto conversion produced357203bytes in135.367ms.

+The statistics query reports no nonzero error/data_loss rows. Both conversion
+and query retain an stderr warning that arm64 syscall traces are unsupported;
+this fixture does not capture syscalls, but the warning must not be erased or
+presented as universal conversion support. The binary is release58.2/add693d8b,
+not the Chromium-linked403906f4 build.

+The malformed6bytes `0a ff ff ff 7f 01` declare a TracePacket much larger than
+the available payload. The converter nevertheless exits0 after69.541ms. Its
+partial output was deleted as declared; raw malformed input and command diagnostics
+remain. Overall probe3817.145ms, watchdog4285ms/558864KiB sampled peak, normal
+pressure. Terminal remains failed; successful fixture subchecks do not admit the
+original unguarded converter architecture. No native capture is repeated.
+
+The public release [Trace schema](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897/protos/perfetto/trace/trace.proto)
+defines only repeated length-delimited TracePacket field1. This supports a narrow
+next investigation: strict streaming outer-envelope validation before conversion,
+including exact declared-length consumption and EOF, while preserving every
+packet byte. It is not a replacement protobuf semantic decoder. Full source/
+identity binding, parser statistics, actual callback attribution and meaningful
+negative controls remain necessary. The accepted empty conversion exposes an
+explicit completeness boundary; extending the timeout or rerunning the browser
+cannot repair it. Independent review and a prospective retained-data-only checkpoint
+precede any revised admission result.
+
+### 🧱 Retained-data checkpoint: strict outer-envelope guard
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution.** Independent nonimplementing
+review confirms the concrete268435455-byte packet claim versus one available
+payload byte. A separately bounded offline framing investigation is justified;
+it cannot validate opaque inner packet semantics, detect a missing whole final
+packet, establish full converter fidelity or predict deadline headroom.
+
+Declare one browserless execution on the already retained136693-byte proto, with
+its original raw SHA256 required at chunk sizes1/2/7/65536. Validate only field1's
+length-delimited wrapper, uint32 length bounds, exact payload consumption and EOF;
+retain every payload byte unchanged. Exercise12 malformed/empty/overflow/wrong-tag/

+verifier SHA256 `124c3909aff9037fd4d5a0c46e67106e11fd4ae18c6f164280f3b61c2ac5813b`.

+truncation before conversion. The first native capability probe remains failed;
+implementation admission still needs explicit transport/derived-output identity,
+converter-error/statistics and known semantic/attribution contracts, then full
+native acceptance with unchanged categories/workload/deadline.

+That offline execution passed once: the retained136693bytes contain2441 complete

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+PR264 landed as `1045e729c391c47a9b6a895782a2fa69dc6fa044`; its
+[immutable documentation acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96911f50e2a8fb7db0b7361485b5075832e67a47/docs/review-assets/spn-144-registration-7aee6699)
+retains both100/100 exact-head reviews and all seven documentation gates. Runtime
+and Storybook execution were explicitly inapplicable, not credited as tests.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 public
+[handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc),
+[configuration](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_config.cc),
+[backend](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_tracing_backend.cc)
+and [consumer](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/perfetto/consumer_host.cc)
+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.
+
+The pinned Chromium tree references Perfetto commit
+`403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649`. Its public
+[launcher manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649/tools/trace_processor)
+pins official native v58.2 binaries, including mac-arm64 SHA256
+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`
+(13,597,976 bytes), and linux-amd64 SHA256
+`58042408e6cc861fb1a731c26bb082dc222285561eaa4e12a48a8b2b90dca7b9`
+(14,897,560 bytes). The prebuilt release is not asserted byte-identical to Chromium's
+linked library. [Public conversion documentation](https://perfetto.dev/docs/quickstart/traceconv)
+supports native proto→Chrome JSON; conversion is not assumed universally lossless.
+Read the manifest only; no Python launcher is added or executed.
+
+Declare one finite local capability sequence, separate from application acceptance:
+
+- Download the exact mac-arm64 official binary once into a task-owned temporary
+  directory, require the manifest size/hash before making it executable, and run
+  version/convert-help/query-help once each (10s per metadata command). Stop if
+  the expected supported commands or identity cannot be established.
+- Run exactly one JSON and one proto capture sequentially on the installed pinned
+  Chromium, fresh isolated contexts, synthetic local HTTP page, same full six trace
+  categories/non-overwriting1GiB buffer and4× CPU throttle. The fixture installs one
+  cancelled timeout, an interval firing exactly three times and one final timeout,
+  with named functions, known source and native text input. This is a short protocol
+  capability fixture, not a smaller substitute for the2086-input acceptance workload.
+- Keep complete raw outputs and source bytes with SHA256. Convert the proto once
+  with the verified native tool; inspect nonzero error/data-loss statistics once.
+  Require all known timer identities/install/fire/remove behavior, callable source/
+  stack fields, timestamps/durations and complete JSON parsing under the existing
+  reader. Compare normalized fixture contracts, not unrelated background event
+  counts or a byte-for-byte equivalence of separate captures.
+- Run one malformed-protobuf conversion negative control; require failure, retain
+  its diagnostics and reject any partial output. This cannot prove all corruption
+  detection or full-trace semantic equivalence; later implementation controls must
+  bind transport/converted identities and reject ambiguous conversion.
+- Bounds:120s overall after metadata preflight,30s per capture/collection,20s per
+  converter/statistics process,5s for malformed input;64MiB raw per capture and
+  256MiB converted output. Serialize under the existing normal-pressure/2GiB combined
+  process-tree watchdog. Retain first failure and authorize no automatic repetition.
+  Always close known CDP streams, detach sessions, close contexts/browser/HTTP server
+  and terminate owned child processes; keep successful evidence, remove only owned
+  partial outputs. A timeout never becomes a pass because cleanup later succeeds.
+
+Only a complete pass admits further investigation of this supported architecture.
+It does not establish full historical420s headroom, full event-equivalence, hosted
+resource bounds or fix the original failure. A failure rejects the proposed
+capability as observed; inspect its concrete cause before revising any plan. The
+eventual candidate still needs complete native pairs and all original acceptance.
+Operator trades a pinned additional development tool for potentially bounded export;
+Owner/Collaborator require full source/lifetime fidelity, and Link guest retains
+unchanged access checks. No production dependency, UI change or authority expansion
+is selected by this checkpoint.
+
+Metadata preflight passed once: exact manifest bytes/hash, native version
+`Perfetto v58.2-add693d8b (add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897)`, RPC14,

+limit from475s to130s, allowing at most10s failure cleanup beyond the probe's120s
+success deadline. This is not a change to the420s application acceptance budget.

+### 🚫 First capability result: conversion is permissive on truncated input
+
+The declared probe ran once and **failed** its negative control. Both captures
+completed on actual Chromium156.0.8078.4 with unchanged settings and positive
+stream/session/context/browser/server cleanup. JSON retained411781bytes SHA256
+`accef97b28f622c3998e3403d16973422fd37030504ea23354ee8f46fb468713`;
+proto retained136693bytes SHA256
+`50a46a4f2151840f1252cab658cdc84b8e3896835790eb75a018266cb6489c8d`.
+The same three known timer installs, cancelled timeout with zero fires, three
+interval fires/removal, final timeout fire, source/script/line/column fields,
+named FunctionCalls/durations and markers passed in native JSON and converted
+proto. Existing strict JSON reader accepted both complete envelopes. Separate
+captures have different background events/timings; no complete event equivalence
+or performance gain is inferred. Proto conversion produced357203bytes in135.367ms.
+
+The statistics query reports no nonzero error/data_loss rows. Both conversion
+and query retain an stderr warning that arm64 syscall traces are unsupported;
+this fixture does not capture syscalls, but the warning must not be erased or
+presented as universal conversion support. The binary is release58.2/add693d8b,
+not the Chromium-linked403906f4 build.
+
+The malformed6bytes `0a ff ff ff 7f 01` declare a TracePacket much larger than
+the available payload. The converter nevertheless exits0 after69.541ms. Its
+partial output was deleted as declared; raw malformed input and command diagnostics
+remain. Overall probe3817.145ms, watchdog4285ms/558864KiB sampled peak, normal
+pressure. Terminal remains failed; successful fixture subchecks do not admit the
+original unguarded converter architecture. No native capture is repeated.
+
+The public release [Trace schema](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897/protos/perfetto/trace/trace.proto)
+defines only repeated length-delimited TracePacket field1. This supports a narrow
+next investigation: strict streaming outer-envelope validation before conversion,
+including exact declared-length consumption and EOF, while preserving every
+packet byte. It is not a replacement protobuf semantic decoder. Full source/
+identity binding, parser statistics, actual callback attribution and meaningful
+negative controls remain necessary. The accepted empty conversion exposes an
+explicit completeness boundary; extending the timeout or rerunning the browser
+cannot repair it. Independent review and a prospective retained-data-only checkpoint
+precede any revised admission result.
+
+### 🧱 Retained-data checkpoint: strict outer-envelope guard
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution.** Independent nonimplementing
+review confirms the concrete268435455-byte packet claim versus one available
+payload byte. A separately bounded offline framing investigation is justified;
+it cannot validate opaque inner packet semantics, detect a missing whole final
+packet, establish full converter fidelity or predict deadline headroom.

+its original raw SHA256 required at chunk sizes1/2/7/65536. Validate only field1's

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion

+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.

+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`

+Declare one finite local capability sequence, separate from application acceptance:

+- Download the exact mac-arm64 official binary once into a task-owned temporary
+  directory, require the manifest size/hash before making it executable, and run

+  with named functions, known source and native text input. This is a short protocol

+  with the verified native tool; inspect nonzero error/data-loss statistics once.
+  Require all known timer identities/install/fire/remove behavior, callable source/

+  detection or full-trace semantic equivalence; later implementation controls must
+  bind transport/converted identities and reject ambiguous conversion.

+  and terminate owned child processes; keep successful evidence, remove only owned
+  partial outputs. A timeout never becomes a pass because cleanup later succeeds.

+eventual candidate still needs complete native pairs and all original acceptance.

+Owner/Collaborator require full source/lifetime fidelity, and Link guest retains
+unchanged access checks. No production dependency, UI change or authority expansion
+is selected by this checkpoint.

+The public release [Trace schema](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897/protos/perfetto/trace/trace.proto)

+# 🔬 SPN-144 local capability evidence
+
+These gzip files retain exact original bytes under `manifest.json`; inspect with
+`gzip -dc FILE.gz`. The first native capability probe **failed** because the
+official converter accepted a truncated protobuf envelope. Scoped timer/source
+subchecks passed, but are not full semantic fidelity or historical deadline proof.
+The separate browserless outer-envelope guard passed on retained bytes and fixed
+negative inputs; it explicitly does not validate opaque packet semantics or loss
+of a complete final packet. The original browser captures were not repeated.
+
+The [canonical checkpoint](../../SPN-144.md#-capability-checkpoint-native-trace-format-and-external-conversion)
+records prospective counts, budgets, source/script/binary identities, first failure,
+independent review, limitations and the next missing evidence. All raw captured
+JSON/proto and converted JSON bytes, fixture source, semantic records, command
+outputs, scripts and watchdogs are retained here. The failed converter's partial
+malformed-output file was removed as declared; its six-byte input and exit0 receipt
+remain. Successful fixture cleanup is not successful capability acceptance.
+
+The official native13,597,976-byte mac-arm64 binary is not vendored. Its pinned
+version, immutable public manifest/download authority and SHA256 remain in the
+canonical record/preflight source. Public upstream source is referenced by pinned
+URLs; no modified upstream implementation is included. The preflight's version and
+help output are retained, including the actual supported CLI arguments.
+
+Registration main validation and its final-description-only cancelled run are
+also retained. Four failed guards in that cancelled run remain failed and fully
+explained; they are not runtime assertion failures. No unperformed or cancelled
+work is credited as a pass. These receipts supplement registration PR264 and its
+immutable registration archive without causing another PR body-edit loop.
+
+## 🧭 v59.1 authority and guarded integration
+
+The `v59-*` and `integrated-*` files retain the newer pinned converter investigation,
+including failed verifier checks and each bounded repair. The immutable official
+manifest and ancestry receipt support the version choice. The v59.1 binary is
+not vendored. Independent capability/architecture reviews are distinct from
+final exact-commit grades.
+
+The implemented wrapper converted the original proto once and queried statistics
+once. Its full derived trace matches all1249 events and every metadata field of
+the previous59.1 conversion except two converter-duration counters; both full
+outputs are retained unchanged. Browserless verifier repairs preserve original
+failures rather than replacing them. Malformed input and wrong expected identity
+fail before converter execution and clean up their owned working files. These
+small-data results and local controls do **not** prove the full native420-second
+deadline, Linux execution, arbitrary inner-packet fidelity or release acceptance.

+
+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+PR264 landed as `1045e729c391c47a9b6a895782a2fa69dc6fa044`; its
+[immutable documentation acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96911f50e2a8fb7db0b7361485b5075832e67a47/docs/review-assets/spn-144-registration-7aee6699)
+retains both100/100 exact-head reviews and all seven documentation gates. Runtime
+and Storybook execution were explicitly inapplicable, not credited as tests.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 public
+[handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc),
+[configuration](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_config.cc),
+[backend](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_tracing_backend.cc)
+and [consumer](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/perfetto/consumer_host.cc)
+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.
+
+The pinned Chromium tree references Perfetto commit
+`403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649`. Its public
+[launcher manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649/tools/trace_processor)
+pins official native v58.2 binaries, including mac-arm64 SHA256
+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`
+(13,597,976 bytes), and linux-amd64 SHA256
+`58042408e6cc861fb1a731c26bb082dc222285561eaa4e12a48a8b2b90dca7b9`
+(14,897,560 bytes). The prebuilt release is not asserted byte-identical to Chromium's
+linked library. [Public conversion documentation](https://perfetto.dev/docs/quickstart/traceconv)
+supports native proto→Chrome JSON; conversion is not assumed universally lossless.
+Read the manifest only; no Python launcher is added or executed.
+
+Declare one finite local capability sequence, separate from application acceptance:
+
+- Download the exact mac-arm64 official binary once into a task-owned temporary
+  directory, require the manifest size/hash before making it executable, and run
+  version/convert-help/query-help once each (10s per metadata command). Stop if
+  the expected supported commands or identity cannot be established.
+- Run exactly one JSON and one proto capture sequentially on the installed pinned
+  Chromium, fresh isolated contexts, synthetic local HTTP page, same full six trace
+  categories/non-overwriting1GiB buffer and4× CPU throttle. The fixture installs one
+  cancelled timeout, an interval firing exactly three times and one final timeout,
+  with named functions, known source and native text input. This is a short protocol
+  capability fixture, not a smaller substitute for the2086-input acceptance workload.
+- Keep complete raw outputs and source bytes with SHA256. Convert the proto once
+  with the verified native tool; inspect nonzero error/data-loss statistics once.
+  Require all known timer identities/install/fire/remove behavior, callable source/
+  stack fields, timestamps/durations and complete JSON parsing under the existing
+  reader. Compare normalized fixture contracts, not unrelated background event
+  counts or a byte-for-byte equivalence of separate captures.
+- Run one malformed-protobuf conversion negative control; require failure, retain
+  its diagnostics and reject any partial output. This cannot prove all corruption
+  detection or full-trace semantic equivalence; later implementation controls must
+  bind transport/converted identities and reject ambiguous conversion.
+- Bounds:120s overall after metadata preflight,30s per capture/collection,20s per
+  converter/statistics process,5s for malformed input;64MiB raw per capture and
+  256MiB converted output. Serialize under the existing normal-pressure/2GiB combined
+  process-tree watchdog. Retain first failure and authorize no automatic repetition.
+  Always close known CDP streams, detach sessions, close contexts/browser/HTTP server
+  and terminate owned child processes; keep successful evidence, remove only owned
+  partial outputs. A timeout never becomes a pass because cleanup later succeeds.
+
+Only a complete pass admits further investigation of this supported architecture.
+It does not establish full historical420s headroom, full event-equivalence, hosted
+resource bounds or fix the original failure. A failure rejects the proposed
+capability as observed; inspect its concrete cause before revising any plan. The
+eventual candidate still needs complete native pairs and all original acceptance.
+Operator trades a pinned additional development tool for potentially bounded export;
+Owner/Collaborator require full source/lifetime fidelity, and Link guest retains
+unchanged access checks. No production dependency, UI change or authority expansion
+is selected by this checkpoint.
+
+Metadata preflight passed once: exact manifest bytes/hash, native version
+`Perfetto v58.2-add693d8b (add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897)`, RPC14,
+convert-json and query help. Watchdog956ms/182960KiB sampled peak, normal pressure.
+The pinned release's query help specifies CSV output and does not expose the newer
+website's format/agent flags; use only its supported arguments. No browser has
+run for this probe yet. Probe script SHA256 before execution:
+`7df58b43219ff3d15430457b04c9d6e8583fded4f2c36a0fee52e924d947db93`.
+The external watchdog keeps the same pressure/2GiB rules and tightens its wall
+limit from475s to130s, allowing at most10s failure cleanup beyond the probe's120s
+success deadline. This is not a change to the420s application acceptance budget.
+

+completed on actual Chromium156.0.8078.4 with unchanged settings and positive
+stream/session/context/browser/server cleanup. JSON retained411781bytes SHA256

+## 🔬 Capability checkpoint: native trace format and external conversion
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution · agent judgment.** Registration
+PR264 landed as `1045e729c391c47a9b6a895782a2fa69dc6fa044`; its
+[immutable documentation acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/96911f50e2a8fb7db0b7361485b5075832e67a47/docs/review-assets/spn-144-registration-7aee6699)

+and Storybook execution were explicitly inapplicable, not credited as tests.
+
+Pinned Chromium156.0.8078.4 public
+[handler](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/content/browser/devtools/protocol/tracing_handler.cc),
+[configuration](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_config.cc),
+[backend](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/public/cpp/perfetto/perfetto_tracing_backend.cc)
+and [consumer](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/refs/tags/156.0.8078.4/services/tracing/perfetto/consumer_host.cc)
+show that JSON transport sets convert_to_legacy_json and invokes Perfetto's
+TraceProcessorStorage/ExportJson inside the browser before stream completion.
+Proto transport selects the raw buffer path while retaining configured categories
+and buffers. This identifies a supported alternative dependency path, not the
+cause or duration of the failed run. No reduced workload/category is proposed.
+
+The pinned Chromium tree references Perfetto commit
+`403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649`. Its public
+[launcher manifest](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/403906f4adfbf287a02e5546f8430dcc9d56b649/tools/trace_processor)
+pins official native v58.2 binaries, including mac-arm64 SHA256
+`d29864d1ba3b36855527bb1b0ca3aa7f703cdce338b9680bb922c5c151b358fa`
+(13,597,976 bytes), and linux-amd64 SHA256
+`58042408e6cc861fb1a731c26bb082dc222285561eaa4e12a48a8b2b90dca7b9`
+(14,897,560 bytes). The prebuilt release is not asserted byte-identical to Chromium's
+linked library. [Public conversion documentation](https://perfetto.dev/docs/quickstart/traceconv)
+supports native proto→Chrome JSON; conversion is not assumed universally lossless.
+Read the manifest only; no Python launcher is added or executed.
+
+Declare one finite local capability sequence, separate from application acceptance:
+
+- Download the exact mac-arm64 official binary once into a task-owned temporary
+  directory, require the manifest size/hash before making it executable, and run
+  version/convert-help/query-help once each (10s per metadata command). Stop if
+  the expected supported commands or identity cannot be established.
+- Run exactly one JSON and one proto capture sequentially on the installed pinned
+  Chromium, fresh isolated contexts, synthetic local HTTP page, same full six trace
+  categories/non-overwriting1GiB buffer and4× CPU throttle. The fixture installs one
+  cancelled timeout, an interval firing exactly three times and one final timeout,
+  with named functions, known source and native text input. This is a short protocol
+  capability fixture, not a smaller substitute for the2086-input acceptance workload.
+- Keep complete raw outputs and source bytes with SHA256. Convert the proto once
+  with the verified native tool; inspect nonzero error/data-loss statistics once.
+  Require all known timer identities/install/fire/remove behavior, callable source/
+  stack fields, timestamps/durations and complete JSON parsing under the existing
+  reader. Compare normalized fixture contracts, not unrelated background event
+  counts or a byte-for-byte equivalence of separate captures.
+- Run one malformed-protobuf conversion negative control; require failure, retain
+  its diagnostics and reject any partial output. This cannot prove all corruption
+  detection or full-trace semantic equivalence; later implementation controls must
+  bind transport/converted identities and reject ambiguous conversion.
+- Bounds:120s overall after metadata preflight,30s per capture/collection,20s per
+  converter/statistics process,5s for malformed input;64MiB raw per capture and
+  256MiB converted output. Serialize under the existing normal-pressure/2GiB combined
+  process-tree watchdog. Retain first failure and authorize no automatic repetition.
+  Always close known CDP streams, detach sessions, close contexts/browser/HTTP server
+  and terminate owned child processes; keep successful evidence, remove only owned
+  partial outputs. A timeout never becomes a pass because cleanup later succeeds.
+
+Only a complete pass admits further investigation of this supported architecture.
+It does not establish full historical420s headroom, full event-equivalence, hosted
+resource bounds or fix the original failure. A failure rejects the proposed
+capability as observed; inspect its concrete cause before revising any plan. The
+eventual candidate still needs complete native pairs and all original acceptance.
+Operator trades a pinned additional development tool for potentially bounded export;
+Owner/Collaborator require full source/lifetime fidelity, and Link guest retains
+unchanged access checks. No production dependency, UI change or authority expansion
+is selected by this checkpoint.
+
+Metadata preflight passed once: exact manifest bytes/hash, native version
+`Perfetto v58.2-add693d8b (add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897)`, RPC14,
+convert-json and query help. Watchdog956ms/182960KiB sampled peak, normal pressure.

+website's format/agent flags; use only its supported arguments. No browser has

+limit from475s to130s, allowing at most10s failure cleanup beyond the probe's120s
+success deadline. This is not a change to the420s application acceptance budget.

+### 🚫 First capability result: conversion is permissive on truncated input
+
+The declared probe ran once and **failed** its negative control. Both captures
+completed on actual Chromium156.0.8078.4 with unchanged settings and positive
+stream/session/context/browser/server cleanup. JSON retained411781bytes SHA256
+`accef97b28f622c3998e3403d16973422fd37030504ea23354ee8f46fb468713`;
+proto retained136693bytes SHA256
+`50a46a4f2151840f1252cab658cdc84b8e3896835790eb75a018266cb6489c8d`.
+The same three known timer installs, cancelled timeout with zero fires, three
+interval fires/removal, final timeout fire, source/script/line/column fields,
+named FunctionCalls/durations and markers passed in native JSON and converted
+proto. Existing strict JSON reader accepted both complete envelopes. Separate
+captures have different background events/timings; no complete event equivalence
+or performance gain is inferred. Proto conversion produced357203bytes in135.367ms.
+
+The statistics query reports no nonzero error/data_loss rows. Both conversion
+and query retain an stderr warning that arm64 syscall traces are unsupported;
+this fixture does not capture syscalls, but the warning must not be erased or
+presented as universal conversion support. The binary is release58.2/add693d8b,
+not the Chromium-linked403906f4 build.
+
+The malformed6bytes `0a ff ff ff 7f 01` declare a TracePacket much larger than
+the available payload. The converter nevertheless exits0 after69.541ms. Its
+partial output was deleted as declared; raw malformed input and command diagnostics
+remain. Overall probe3817.145ms, watchdog4285ms/558864KiB sampled peak, normal
+pressure. Terminal remains failed; successful fixture subchecks do not admit the
+original unguarded converter architecture. No native capture is repeated.
+
+The public release [Trace schema](https://github.com/google/perfetto/blob/add693d8b338ba9599dbcbc3e300b1ab8c000897/protos/perfetto/trace/trace.proto)
+defines only repeated length-delimited TracePacket field1. This supports a narrow
+next investigation: strict streaming outer-envelope validation before conversion,
+including exact declared-length consumption and EOF, while preserving every
+packet byte. It is not a replacement protobuf semantic decoder. Full source/
+identity binding, parser statistics, actual callback attribution and meaningful
+negative controls remain necessary. The accepted empty conversion exposes an
+explicit completeness boundary; extending the timeout or rerunning the browser
+cannot repair it. Independent review and a prospective retained-data-only checkpoint

+### 🧱 Retained-data checkpoint: strict outer-envelope guard
+
+**2026-11-04 · Prospective, before execution.** Independent nonimplementing
+review confirms the concrete268435455-byte packet claim versus one available
+payload byte. A separately bounded offline framing investigation is justified;
+it cannot validate opaque inner packet semantics, detect a missing whole final

+Read-only version investigation found a concrete compatibility limit in the
